description: The line plot illustrates the relationship between the number of reasoning steps and the Pass@1 Rate (%) for the GPT-4o model, as evaluated in the VisuoThink framework. The x-axis, labeled “Num. of Reasoning Steps,” is linear and spans from 5 to 40, with major tick marks at 5, 10, 20, and 40. The y-axis, labeled “Pass@1 Rate (%)”, is also linear, ranging from 0 to 100 with tick marks at intervals of 20. Two lines are plotted: one solid blue line with circular markers representing GPT-4o, and one light blue dashed line with cross markers, also labeled GPT-4o in the legend (suggesting a possible duplicate or comparative condition not explicitly differentiated in the legend). The solid blue line begins at 6.5% at 5 steps, rises to 32.3% at 10 steps, reaches 77.4% at 20 steps, and ends at 83.9% at 40 steps. The dashed light blue line starts at 19.4% at 5 steps, increases to 38.7% at 10 steps, jumps to 87.1% at 20 steps, and plateaus slightly at 89.2% at 40 steps. Both lines show a consistent upward trend, with the dashed line consistently outperforming the solid line across all step counts.
